# JSON-LD examples {#sec-examples}

[Informative]{.status}

These examples show Things described in Parts I and II as JSON-LD (@sec-binding-json-ld), following the whale sightings application (@sec-app-whales).

Namespaces are not yet decided ([decision 0006](https://github.com/NMEA-Cloud/Framework/blob/main/decisions/0006-namespaces.md)),
so the framework's own terms are written under `https://example.org/vocab/`, and the examples share a context published at `https://example.org/context.jsonld`.
Terms reused from other vocabularies, such as Darwin Core [@darwin-core] and the DCMI metadata terms, keep their published IRIs.
The terms and values are illustrative: the candidate terms of each vocabulary module have not been agreed.

## The context {#sec-example-context}

```json
{
  "@context": {
    "@vocab": "https://example.org/vocab/",
    "dwc": "http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/",
    "dwciri": "http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/iri/",
    "dcterms": "http://purl.org/dc/terms/",
    "prov": "http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#",
    "rdfs": "http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#",
    "xsd": "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#",
    "label": "rdfs:label",
    "issuer": {
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "refersTo": {
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "subject": {
      "@type": "@vocab"
    },
    "action": {
      "@type": "@vocab"
    },
    "area": {
      "@type": "@json"
    },
    "validity": {
      "@type": "@json"
    },
    "lastKnownPlace": {
      "@type": "@json"
    },
    "derivedFrom": {
      "@id": "prov:wasDerivedFrom",
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "license": {
      "@id": "dcterms:license",
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "monitor": {
      "@id": "http://www.iana.org/assignments/relation/monitor",
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "carriedOverAis": {
      "@type": "@json"
    },
    "dwc:eventDate": {
      "@type": "xsd:dateTime"
    },
    "dwc:decimalLatitude": {
      "@type": "xsd:decimal"
    },
    "dwc:decimalLongitude": {
      "@type": "xsd:decimal"
    },
    "dwc:coordinateUncertaintyInMeters": {
      "@type": "xsd:decimal"
    },
    "dwc:individualCount": {
      "@type": "xsd:integer"
    },
    "relativeTo": {
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "rules": {
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "status": {
      "@type": "@vocab"
    },
    "distanceInMeters": {
      "@type": "xsd:decimal"
    },
    "responsibleAuthority": {
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "dwciri:recordedBy": {
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "event": {
      "@type": "@id"
    },
    "organism": {
      "@type": "@id"
    }
  }
}
```

`area`, `validity` and `lastKnownPlace` are JSON literals holding JSON-FG geometry and time objects [@ogc-json-fg], so that a place keeps JSON-FG's own form, including circular arcs.
`carriedOverAis` is a JSON literal too, so that the examples have no blank nodes and can be signed cheaply (@sec-trust-security).
`monitor` is named by the IANA relation IRI ([NCF-BND-JSONLD-002](../bindings/json-ld.qmd#ncf-bnd-jsonld-002)),
and `license` is `dcterms:license`, one way of stating terms of use ([NCF-SEM-020](../overview/semantic-model.qmd#ncf-sem-020)).
Darwin Core terms in the `dwc:` namespace hold text, as Darwin Core intends, and those in the `dwciri:` namespace hold IRIs (@sec-sightings-organisms).

## An organism {#sec-example-organism}

Kitkat, a North Atlantic right whale, as a Thing in her own right (@sec-sightings-organisms).
Her species is identified by its identifier in the World Register of Marine Species [@worms].
Her last known place was updated from a sighting, and she names the version of the sighting it was derived from (@sec-provenance).

```json
{
  "@context": "https://example.org/context.jsonld",
  "@id": "https://example.org/organisms/kitkat",
  "@type": "dwc:Organism",
  "dwc:organismName": "Kitkat",
  "dwc:scientificName": "Eubalaena glacialis",
  "dwc:scientificNameID": "urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:159023",
  "lastKnownPlace": {
    "type": "Point",
    "coordinates": [
      -69.95,
      41.8
    ]
  },
  "derivedFrom": "https://example.org/sightings/1/versions/1"
}
```

## A sighting {#sec-example-sighting}

A sighting of Kitkat with a calf: one event containing two occurrences (@sec-vocab-observations).

```json
{
  "@context": "https://example.org/context.jsonld",
  "@graph": [
    {
      "@id": "https://example.org/sightings/1",
      "@type": "dwc:Event",
      "dwc:eventDate": "2026-10-25T11:40:00Z",
      "dwc:decimalLatitude": 41.8,
      "dwc:decimalLongitude": -69.95,
      "dwc:coordinateUncertaintyInMeters": 200,
      "dwc:basisOfRecord": "HumanObservation",
      "dwc:recordedByID": "https://example.org/people/observer-1",
      "dwciri:recordedBy": "https://example.org/people/observer-1",
      "license": "https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/"
    },
    {
      "@id": "https://example.org/sightings/1/a",
      "@type": "dwc:Occurrence",
      "dwc:eventID": "https://example.org/sightings/1",
      "event": "https://example.org/sightings/1",
      "organism": "https://example.org/organisms/kitkat",
      "dwc:organismID": "https://example.org/organisms/kitkat",
      "dwc:scientificName": "Eubalaena glacialis",
      "dwc:individualCount": 1,
      "dwc:sex": "female",
      "dwc:lifeStage": "adult"
    },
    {
      "@id": "https://example.org/sightings/1/b",
      "@type": "dwc:Occurrence",
      "dwc:eventID": "https://example.org/sightings/1",
      "event": "https://example.org/sightings/1",
      "dwc:scientificName": "Eubalaena glacialis",
      "dwc:individualCount": 1,
      "dwc:lifeStage": "calf"
    }
  ]
}
```

Each occurrence refers to the event, and the first to Kitkat, twice: as text in `dwc:eventID` and `dwc:organismID`, for Darwin Core tools, and by IRI in `event` and `organism`, which make the links (@sec-relationships).
The event names its observer the same two ways, in `dwc:recordedByID` and `dwciri:recordedBy`.
The event's license, CC BY 4.0, also governs its occurrences, which state none of their own and are part of the event (@sec-rights).
The calf has not been identified, so its occurrence refers to no organism.

## A notice {#sec-example-notice}

An exclusion zone that a wildlife management agency creates around Kitkat after the sighting (@sec-vocab-notices).

```json
{
  "@context": "https://example.org/context.jsonld",
  "@id": "https://example.org/notices/kitkat-zone",
  "@type": "Notice",
  "issuer": "https://example.org/authorities/wildlife-agency",
  "subject": "marineMammalsInArea",
  "action": "reduceSpeed",
  "text": "Right whale and calf in area. Reduce speed to 10 knots.",
  "area": {
    "type": "CurvePolygon",
    "geometries": [
      {
        "type": "CircularString",
        "coordinates": [
          [
            -69.95,
            41.808993
          ],
          [
            -69.937934,
            41.8
          ],
          [
            -69.95,
            41.791007
          ],
          [
            -69.962066,
            41.8
          ],
          [
            -69.95,
            41.808993
          ]
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "validity": {
    "interval": [
      "2026-10-25T12:00:00Z",
      "2026-10-26T12:00:00Z"
    ]
  },
  "refersTo": [
    "https://example.org/organisms/kitkat"
  ],
  "carriedOverAis": [
    {
      "station": "003669999",
      "linkage": 17
    }
  ],
  "license": "https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/",
  "monitor": "https://example.org/notices/kitkat-zone/events"
}
```

The notice refers to Kitkat, not to the sighting.
Its area is a circle of 1 km radius, a curve polygon of one circular string with two arcs;
its validity is an interval.
`carriedOverAis` lists every AIS station and linkage identifier it is carried under, its aliases ([NCF-BND-AIS-001](../bindings/ais.qmd#ncf-bnd-ais-001)).

## The notice as a JSON-FG feature {#sec-example-notice-fg}

The same notice for clients that read features, with its IRI as the feature's `id`.

```json
{
  "type": "Feature",
  "id": "https://example.org/notices/kitkat-zone",
  "featureType": "Notice",
  "time": {
    "interval": [
      "2026-10-25T12:00:00Z",
      "2026-10-26T12:00:00Z"
    ]
  },
  "place": {
    "type": "CurvePolygon",
    "geometries": [
      {
        "type": "CircularString",
        "coordinates": [
          [
            -69.95,
            41.808993
          ],
          [
            -69.937934,
            41.8
          ],
          [
            -69.95,
            41.791007
          ],
          [
            -69.962066,
            41.8
          ],
          [
            -69.95,
            41.808993
          ]
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "geometry": null,
  "properties": {
    "issuer": "https://example.org/authorities/wildlife-agency",
    "subject": "marineMammalsInArea",
    "action": "reduceSpeed",
    "text": "Right whale and calf in area. Reduce speed to 10 knots.",
    "refersTo": [
      "https://example.org/organisms/kitkat"
    ]
  }
}
```

Its area is the feature's `place` and its validity its `time`.
`geometry` is `null` because the area has arcs, which GeoJSON cannot express.

## A management area that moves with an organism {#sec-example-management-area}

A rule an agency sets for North Atlantic right whales: vessels keep 1000 m clear.
It is relative to the species, identified by its WoRMS identifier, so it applies around every right whale (@sec-management-areas).

```json
{
  "@context": "https://example.org/context.jsonld",
  "@id": "https://example.org/areas/right-whale-approach",
  "@type": "ManagementArea",
  "label": "Right whale approach zone",
  "responsibleAuthority": "https://example.org/authorities/wildlife-agency",
  "rules": "https://example.org/regulations/right-whale-approach",
  "relativeTo": "urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:159023",
  "distanceInMeters": 1000
}
```

## A notice of the management area {#sec-example-management-area-notice}

The notice that the zone is active around Kitkat.
It refers to the management area and to Kitkat, and gives the area the zone covers now, from Kitkat's last known place;
as she moves, the notice is updated.
Its validity has no end: the agency marks it inactive, for example when Kitkat's position becomes too uncertain.

```json
{
  "@context": "https://example.org/context.jsonld",
  "@id": "https://example.org/notices/kitkat-approach",
  "@type": "Notice",
  "issuer": "https://example.org/authorities/wildlife-agency",
  "refersTo": [
    "https://example.org/areas/right-whale-approach",
    "https://example.org/organisms/kitkat"
  ],
  "status": "active",
  "area": {
    "type": "CurvePolygon",
    "geometries": [
      {
        "type": "CircularString",
        "coordinates": [
          [
            -69.95,
            41.808993
          ],
          [
            -69.937934,
            41.8
          ],
          [
            -69.95,
            41.791007
          ],
          [
            -69.962066,
            41.8
          ],
          [
            -69.95,
            41.808993
          ]
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "validity": {
    "interval": [
      "2026-10-25T12:00:00Z",
      ".."
    ]
  },
  "text": "Right whale approach zone active. Keep 1000 m clear.",
  "license": "https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/",
  "monitor": "https://example.org/notices/kitkat-approach/events"
}
```

::: {.callout-warning title="To be written"}
How a change to a notice, such as an update or a withdrawal, is represented when it is announced to those following it (@sec-binding-json-ld).
A notice received over AIS alone, before its IRI is known (@sec-ais-identity).
:::
